label: Implicants: cubes inside the ON-set
subgoals: List the minterms of the cube
Check every one against the ON-set
Reject the cube if any minterm is OFF

label: Prime implicants: maximal implicants
subgoals: Remove one literal at a time from the implicant
Test whether the enlarged cube is still an implicant
Declare the cube prime when no enlargement survives

label: Recognizing primes in a cover
subgoals: Expand each candidate cube as far as it goes
Compare the candidate with the expanded cube
Pick the candidate that is already maximal
